title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE still executes through unguarded update_reference_call_status — the taken_over_at backstop is dead code and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235-1252: "case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) False -> case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(...) title: NEW: an 'at'-less delivered attempts entry bypasses the post-correction typed gate and exhausts a corrected row (matched_send_at == '' is treated as genuine)
evidence: webhooks.gleam:284-288: "case row.matched_send_at == "" || row.send_is_post_correction { True -> exhaust_row(...) recommended_fix: For corrected rows require the entry timestamp: treat matched_send_at == '' as stand-down (or regex-validate 'at' in the matched_send_at subquery) so only a genuinely dated post-correction send exhausts.
